name: MKX 510 Cartridge | Vanilla Chai Cake
description: Indulge in creamy decadence with Vanilla Chaicake, a hybrid that balances relaxation and focus. One of the 5 limited strains in the 2025 Winter Collection, this dessert-inspired vape combines vanilla, doughy sweetness, and chai spice for a cozy, indulgent experience.
